title: Answer: physics from the relations, consciousness from the intrinsic nature

statements.text: Physics as known emerges from the relations among the fundamental entities, and consciousness as known from their intrinsic nature. Macro experience is constituted by the quiddities on constitutive forms and causally emerges from them on emergentist forms.

sources.quote: Physics as we know it emerges from the relations between these entities, whereas consciousness as we know it emerges from their intrinsic nature.
some claim that macrophenomenal properties emerge from quiddities, or from quiddities and structure
